decisive_items: 4 symmetric concentric ring-shaped opacities in posterior corneal stroma
long bandlike structures with thin streaks of white lines interspersed
Surface of rings: smooth without obvious deposits, pigmentation, or serrations
response.rationale: R3 is the champion because it has strong support from both the clinical description of ring-shaped opacities and the specific findings on confocal microscopy, which are characteristic of corneal amyloidosis. R1 is the runner-up because it also has some supporting evidence, but it is less specific and does not fully explain the bandlike structures seen on microscopy.

rejected.why: Normal serum iron levels contradict this diagnosis.
Lack of comprehensive support for the diagnosis beyond the presence of posterior crocodile shagreen.
It is a subset of R5 and does not provide additional diagnostic value.
